paragraphs.body: Yahoo Sports reports that JJ Redick praised Luka Dončić's defense after the Lakers defeated the Raptors, noting the player's improved defensive performance. ESPN also highlights that Doncic has drawn praise from both the Lakers and Raptors regarding his defensive efforts. Heavy.com adds that the Raptors coach specifically commended Doncic for destroying their game plan during the matchup.

The New York Times describes a history-making night where Dončić was praised for his 'awesome defense.' Bleacher Report quotes JJ Redick saying the Lakers 'live on a spaceship' and that Doncic feels like a 'supernova' as he makes NBA history. Yahoo Sports further notes that Doncic's latest 45-point explosion reveals an incredible scoring trend for the Lakers.

Yahoo Sports mentions that Doncic has a perfect two-word reaction to the praise for his defensive shining. Sun Herald reports that Doncic enjoys a rarefied air ahead of a clash against the Heat. Conversely, Yahoo Sports notes that fans are fuming after Luka Doncic still trails Victor Wembanyama in the MVP race.

headline: Luka Doncic praised for defense and scoring explosion as fans debate his MVP standing ahead of Heat clash.
